Miller Howard Investments Inc Increased Vodafone Group Plc New Sponsor (NASDAQ:VOD) Stake by $44.48 Million 
January 26, 2018 - By Louis Casey 
Miller Howard Investments Inc increased its stake in Vodafone Group Plc New Sponsor (NASDAQ:VOD) by 58.2% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Miller Howard Investments Inc bought 1.43 million shares as the company’s stock rose 16.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.90M shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $124.42M, up from 2.47 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Miller Howard Investments Inc who had been investing in Vodafone Group Plc New Sponsor for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $78.95B market cap company. The stock increased 0.25% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $32.28. About 773,596 shares traded. Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) has declined 13.23% since January 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.93% the S&P500. 
Miller Howard Investments Inc, which manages about $6.68 billion and $4.60 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Energy Transfer Partners Lp Un () by 2.14M shares to 5.51M shares, valued at $98.71 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Crown Castle Intl Corp New Com (NYSE:CCI) by 298,249 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 700,876 shares, and cut its stake in Pitney Bowes Inc Com (NYSE:PBI). 
Miller Howard Investments Inc is a New York-based institutional investor with more than $6.68 billion AUM in May, 2014. Taken from Miller Howard Investments latest Adv, the fund reported to have 45 full and part-time employees. Among which 7 performing investment advisory and research functions. The institutional investor had more than 4300 clients. Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) Ratings Coverage 
Among 9 analysts covering Vodafone Group PLC (ADR) ( NASDAQ:VOD ), 5 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 56% are positive. Vodafone Group PLC (ADR) had 14 analyst reports since October 19, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was upgraded by Bank of America to “Buy” on Wednesday, August 9. The firm has “Reduce” rating given on Thursday, June 1 by Standpoint Research. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Monday, November 21 by BNP Paribas. The company was initiated on Tuesday, January 3 by Standpoint Research. The stock of Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) earned “Neutral” rating by Bank of America on Wednesday, January 25. The rating was upgraded by Argus Research on Monday, June 12 to “Buy”. The rating was upgraded by Macquarie Research on Monday, October 19 to “Outperform”. Barclays Capital upgraded Vodafone Group Plc (NASDAQ:VOD) on Friday, December 8 to “Overweight” rating. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Macquarie Research given on Monday, June 13. Raymond James upgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Wednesday, January 17 report. 
Vodafone Group Plc operates as a telecommunications firm worldwide. The company has market cap of $78.95 billion. The firm offers voice, messaging, and data services across mobile and fixed networks; broadband and TV services; cloud and hosting for storing data and applications in the cloud, as well as Internet protocol-virtual private network services; roaming services; and converged communication services to small businesses and large multinational companies. It currently has negative earnings. It also provides M-Pesa, a mobile money service; GigaKombi; GigaTV, an advanced digital TV service; and Vodafone One, an integrated fixed, mobile, and TV service.
